subject: indiv-td
title: (R)INDIV.TD.------EXT.F.
description: Chart on book p. 117 (T(AF)M-21). INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; EXT-F (extended functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: AFL (affinity alignment) and ATTN (attraction). From AFL: P-FC (particular focus). LK-IMP (linkage implications) is typed below ATTN at the same dot. From ATTN: INFO-F (information focus), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and INFO-ALGN (information alignment). From INFO-F: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From VT-DY: PART (participation). From INFO-ALGN: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From SOC-RT-DY: LANG-DY (language dynamics).
